lines.text: Jesus passed through Galilee teaching His disciples that men would kill Him and after seven days He would rise.

wrong_details.wrong: after seven days He would rise
wrong_details.true: after three days He would rise

lines.text: In the house at Capernaum, the disciples stayed silent because they had argued about which of them was the greatest.
Jesus sat down, called the Twelve, said the first must be last and servant of all, and took a child in His arms.
John said they tried to stop a man driving out demons because he was not from Galilee, but Jesus said not to stop him.
Jesus said a cup of water earns a reward, warned against causing stumbling and sin, and told them to have salt and be at peace.
